verdict.rationale: Brex marketing documents multi-level approval flows routed automatically by amount, vendor and employee role in Bill Pay, plus policy rules defining who must approve expenses. This covers the core multi-step chain. The only escalation evidence is an AI review agent that escalates policy exceptions, not time-based escalation when approvers sit on requests. Missing for 10: approver delegation, time-based escalation or reminders for stalled approvals, explicit manager→budget owner→finance chain configuration docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
